Based on my search, here's how to log in to your **My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**:

## Official Login Page

Go to the official Government of Canada portal:
**https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account.html**

## Sign-In Options

You have **three ways** to log in:

| Method | What You Need |
|--------|-------------|
| **GCKey** | Username and password created with the Government of Canada |
| **Sign-In Partner** | Your online banking credentials from participating banks |
| **Provincial Digital ID** | Available in select provinces (Alberta, British Columbia, and others) |

## Step-by-Step Login Process

1. Visit the official MSCA portal
2. Click **"Sign In"**
3. Choose your preferred sign-in method (GCKey, bank, or provincial ID)
4. Enter your credentials
5. Complete any identity validation or security steps if prompted
6. Access your dashboard

## What You Can Access in MSCA

- Employment Insurance (EI) claims and reports
- Canada Pension Plan (CPP) benefits and contribution history
- Old Age Security (OAS) and Guaranteed Income Supplement (GIS)
- Social Insurance Number (SIN) information
- Direct deposit and mailing address updates
- Tax slips (T4E, T4A(P), T4A(OAS))
- National Student Loans Service Centre (NSLSC) account (as of May 25, 2025)

## Important Notes

- **GCKey is NOT the same as CRA login** — they are separate systems
- If you forgot your GCKey password, use the "Forgot your password" link on the GCKey welcome screen
- For technical issues: clear your browser cache, use updated browsers (Chrome 84+, Safari 13.1.2+, Edge 85+, Firefox 68+), or try incognito mode
- **Service Canada Phone:** 1-800-O-Canada (1-800-622-6232)
- **GCKey Help Desk:** Available Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. ET

## If You Don't Have an Account Yet

You'll need to register first:
1. Request a **Personal Access Code (PAC)** — arrives by mail in 5-10 business days
2. Have your **SIN, date of birth, and postal code** ready
3. Follow the registration steps on the official portal

---

Sources:
1. https://canadaedition.org/tech/my-service-canada-account-login/
2. https://davidsklar.com/blog/osap-login-changed-how-to-access-your-student-loan-through-my-service-canada-account/
3. https://www.insurdinary.ca/my-service-canada-account-guide/
4. https://2ndchance.ca/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/Creating-a-My-Service-Canada-Account.pdf
5. https://wiki.gccollab.ca/images/9/93/MSCA_gckey.pdf
6. https://canpension.ca/articles/how-to-access-and-login-to-the-canada-pension-plan-cpp-account-online
